integrity: The proof derives both Voronoi identities from explicit coordinate support inequalities. Reducedness and completeness then follow from the published Voronoi-cell proposition, with positive homothety for completeness. An exact-rational checker independently enumerates both 24-vertex descriptions and replays finite consistency tests; bounded enumeration is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The construction proves existence in dimension four and does not settle dimension three or classify all simultaneous lattice reduced-complete bodies. It uses the special dual Voronoi geometry of D4 and D4*. A differently phrased or unindexed prior observation remains a residual originality risk.
title: The \(D_4\) 24-cell is lattice reduced and complete
